units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:2">Targ. Ps. CIV, 2</cite> (h. text <he>שלמה</he>).—
<cite ref="Menachot 40b:4">Men. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>שרא</he> … <he>לסְדִינֵיה</he> R. Z. untied the show-fringes of his linen sheet.

Ib. 41ᵃ מיכסי ס׳ he was wrapped in a linen sheet (without show-fringes); ס׳ בקייטא וכ׳ you wear a linen sheet in the summer, and a sarb’la in the winter (without show-fringes), what is to become of the law &c.?; a. fr.—Pl. סְדִינִין, סְדִינַיָּא.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:20">Targ. Lam. II, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:22">22</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:4:4">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> bot. (interpret. <he>סדינים</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:23">Is. III, 23</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:7:3">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הורי … מיטעני בס׳ וכ׳</he> allowed Bar G., the physician, to be carried in a litter to visit the sick on the Sabbath.
